description: One timestamped snapshot of observed GPU asks, not quotes — listings may be gone when you rent. Observes only; never rents, reserves, or holds. Omit gpu for the per-class snapshot. Default type ondemand; use bid for the interruptible spot auction. GET the paid_url with an x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header carrying the USDC authorization. Paid tool — $0.25 per snapshot, USDC on Base or Arbitrum One. Paid URL: https://aemb.pro/v1/markets/compute/spot.

gpu.description: Optional GPU model filter, e.g. 'H100 SXM'

max_gpus.description: Maximum GPU count per offer; integer 1..64

min_gpus.description: Minimum GPU count per offer; integer >= 1

min_reliability.description: Minimum host reliability 0..1 (inclusive); hosts below it are excluded

type.description: Offer type: ondemand (fixed price), bid (interruptible auction — shown price is the bid floor), or reserved (longer commitment)

verified.description: When true, only verified hosts; when false, only unverified hosts
